mapper.sql: l.id, l.student_id, l.type, l.start_at, l.end_at, l.days, l.reason, l.place, l.contact, l.attachment, l.status, l.approver_id, l.approve_note, l.approved_at, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.real_name, ''), a.username) AS approver_name
FROM leave_request l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = l.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = l.approver_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_request (student_id, type, start_at, end_at, days, reason, place, contact, attachment, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{type}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{place}, #{contact}, #{attachment}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_request l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = l.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = #{status} AND sp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId}
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_request SET status = #{to}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_note = #{approveNote}, approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE leave_request SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'pending' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE leave_request SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT l.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM leave_request l LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = l.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND sp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId} GROUP BY l.status

SELECT l.student_id AS student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, MAX(l.created_at) AS last_created FROM leave_request l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = l.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.created_at >= #{since} AND sp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId} GROUP BY l.student_id, student_name, student_no, class_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCount} ORDER BY cnt DESC, last_created DESC
